text:
I went to get dental crowns done there. Let me tell you, it was ridiculously expensive and the workmanship was terrible. The crowns weren't properly fitted and had gaps.
I didn't understand why they did that before, but I had several teeth done there because I had a lot of decay.
Lately, it feels like things are getting worse and worse. The clinic looks dirty and unhygienic. So I tried a clinic near my home, and I just found out the truth: the dental clinic in Don Mueang doesn't do root canal treatment anymore. They just give me crowns, and I've had several teeth done. Some had only half of the root canal treated before getting the crown.
I'm warning anyone considering using their services: your teeth will only get worse.
The dentist at the local clinic is baffled by this kind of treatment; I can't believe it's even in textbooks! Don't use their services. They should shut the clinic down.
